name: Health Platform · API

parameters.content:
## Platform (shared) · API (Google Sheets)
Every request: `POST /webhook/api/v1/<group>` with `{action, data}`. "Read for request" reads only the tabs the action needs (one Sheets request); "Run API" runs the Auth Gate (`fn_gate`: session, role, caregiver scope, password-change and staff 2FA rules) and the action in the engine; "Write for request" saves the changes (one request). AI actions continue in their section. When the request queued events, the event dispatcher starts at once.

nodes.name: Library · engine
nodes.notes: The engine (workflows/src/engine): every former database function, the table rules (types, not-null, check, unique, foreign keys) and the Sheets reads and writes. Loaded by "Run API" and "Data · Run". Tested offline by scripts/engine-tests.

meta.description: The whole Health Platform in one workflow, with its data in Google Sheets: the public API (one Sheets read, the engine with the Auth Gate and the action, one Sheets write), every schedule, the event dispatcher and runner, the AI sections (Companion, intake, explanations, briefs, MedGemma consult, RAG), the Drive knowledge sync, the guideline sync and the error handler.

description: The HTTP API of the platform (/webhook/api/v1/<group>): Auth Gate and action in the engine, one read and one write. Sections run in "Health Platform".
